examples.arabic: الماتش بدأ والناس كلها كانت فرحانة أوي.
examples.english: The match started, and all the people were very happy.
examples.transliteration: El match bada2 wel nas kollaha kanet far7ana awi.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: هو قال السلام عليكم وبعدين بدأ يسأل عن كل حاجة حواليه
examples.english: He said Peace be upon you and then started asking about everything around him
examples.transliteration: Howa al as-salamu alaykum we baden bada yis-al an kol haga hawalih
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: إمبارح علي بدأ أول درس ليه في المطبخ.
examples.english: Yesterday, Ali started his first lesson in the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Imbareh Ali bada awel dars lih fi el matbakh.

examples.arabic: كان المطر بدأ ينزل جامد بره
examples.english: The rain started falling heavily outside.
examples.transliteration: kān il-maṭar bádaʔ yínzil gámid bárra.

examples.arabic: احمد بدأ يومه وهو متحمس يشتري هدوم جديدة للصيف
examples.english: Ahmed started his day excited to buy new clothes for summer.
examples.transliteration: ʼAḥmad bádaʔ yómuh wa húwwa mutaḥammes yeštiri hdúm gedída leṣ-ṣayf.

examples.arabic: بس كريم بدا يسال كتير ايه ده وليه ده وكان زمان عامل ازاي
examples.english: But Karim started asking a lot: "What is this? And why is this? And how was it in the past?"
examples.transliteration: Bass Karim bada yis'al kiteer: "Eih da? W leih da? W kan zaman 3amel izzay?"
